text:
maria: Quick sync — a SE customer is asking for embeddings: batch=1000, dims=1536, and per-item ids. Need a clear API contract and launch criteria.
kevin: 1000 is going to blow memory for hosted. Proposal: cap max_batch=512 for hosted v1, allow 2048 for Dedicated with tenant-level override.
sara: For models, default should be `embed-large-v3`. We should expose a `model` param and include a cheaper `embed-small-quant` option for cost-sensitive workloads.
pranav: Response shape debate: two common asks — array-of-arrays ([[...],[...]]) vs flat buffer + offsets. My vote is array-of-arrays + per-item metadata to keep SDKs simple.
olivia: :point_up: Customers also need deterministic mapping back to inputs when they submit mixed types. Add `input_index` in metadata and allow `client_id` passthrough in request.
kevin: Example request draft: ```json
{ "model": "embed-large-v3", "inputs": ["text1", "text2"], "max_batch": 512 }
``` We'll validate size server-side.
sara: On dims: return model native dimension by default. Allowing an override (e.g., `response_dims`) invites mismatches and hidden quantization; recommend we do NOT support dims override in v1.
maria: Proposed launch criteria: docs + SDK samples, perf: median per-item latency <8ms at batch=64 and 99p <40ms on hosted medium tier; stability: <0.1% 5xx; error surface documented; pilot with 3 customers.
pranav: Edge cases: customers sometimes POST base64 blobs. Enforce request payload limit (10MB) and return 413 with clear message if exceeded. Also define behavior for empty inputs and nulls.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for embed-service v2.3 -> routing 10% traffic to gpus-prod-a (2024-11-10T16:12:08Z)
kevin: We should expose batching metadata in response headers: `X-Embedding-Batch-Size` and `X-Cache-Hit: true|false`. Also add `processing_time_ms` in per-item metadata for observability.
olivia: :thumbsup: Add SDK examples for JS/Python showing how to map returned embeddings back to original inputs. Include a migration note about ordering guarantees.
sara: Implementation note for runtime: use sha256(input + model + truncation) as cache key so prefix caching works. Document cache semantics and TTL.
maria: Action items: @kevin open API spec PR by Wed, @sara add perf tests and bench scripts, @pranav draft error-code page, @olivia recruit 3 pilot customers and capture their acceptance criteria. If anyone sees major blockers call them out here.
kevin: I'll sketch the API PR today and include example responses and header list. Link draft: https://redwood.internal/embeddings-spec (internal).
olivia: I'll reach out to Pilot A and Pilot B and share a short questionnaire about expected batch sizes and latency SLOs.
pranav: One more thing — retry semantics: recommend idempotent uploads by client_id + input_index, and 429 should include `retry_after` with exponential backoff guidance.
maria: Perfect. We'll reconvene after the PR is up. Thanks everyone :rocket:
